name: Can AKN Design Group install a new washer and dryer as part of a larger utility room or home addition project?

mainEntity.name: Can AKN Design Group install a new washer and dryer as part of a larger utility room or home addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, AKN Design Group can incorporate the installation of new washers and dryers as part of a broader utility room renovation or a home addition project. Our expertise lies in comprehensive residential design-build, meaning we integrate such installations into the structural, plumbing, and electrical plans of a larger remodel. We ensure proper ventilation, water lines, drainage, and electrical connections are accounted for in the design and execution. This service is provided as part of a substantial, coordinated renovation, not as a standalone appliance installation or a piecemeal repair, aligning with our focus on enhancing functionality, beauty, and value through integrated solutions.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group installs washers and dryers as part of larger utility room renovations or home additions, ensuring integrated plumbing, electrical, and ventilation.
